about_the_game:
A puzzle roguelike where a dog defends his cat from invading alien cats. Search, survive, and collect magic yarn balls to expose the enemy on the grid!

This demo showcases a game still in development. Some elements may change before the final release.

short_description: A deceptively challenging, vibrant puzzle game with a roguelike inspired element! Find all the invading alien cats hidden in the grid! Can you survive? The demo gives you 5 lives to reach and complete Level 20.
